claims.text: Major public transportation is a five-minute walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: take a five-minute stroll to major public transportation
findings.note: The official page states a five-minute walk to major public transportation.

claims.text: MRT Taipei 101/World Trade Center station is 0.2 kilometers from the hotel.

findings.quote: MRT Taipei 101/World Trade Center station0.2 kilometers
findings.note: The official transportation page lists the station at 0.2 km.

claims.text: Guest rooms are designed with a residential touch.

findings.quote: Designed with a residential touch, each room provides a personal sanctuary
findings.note: The rooms page says rooms are designed with a residential touch.

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the hotel's pastel rooms.

findings.quote: This "grand building" next to the Taipei 101 tower has pastel rooms
findings.note: The Condé Nast Traveler review mentions the pastel rooms.

claims.text: The Grand Executive 101 View Suite has a Taipei 101 view, a living room and a bedroom, a marble bathroom with a bathtub, and Grand Club Lounge access.

findings.quote: Enjoy the Taipei 101 view from the 893 sq ft (83 sq m) home with a living room and a bedroom, a marble bathroom with a bathtub, and access to the Grand Club Lounge.
findings.note: Every listed feature of the Grand Executive 101 View Suite is covered.

claims.text: Executive suites have marble tubs from which guests can watch Taipei 101 light up at sunset.

findings.quote: executive suites with "luxurious marble tubs" from which "you can watch the tower light up as the sun sets."
findings.note: The tower is the Taipei 101 tower named earlier in the same sentence.

claims.text: The Diplomat Suite has a separate living area, a kitchenette, a walk-in closet and a marble bathroom.

findings.quote: suite with a separate living area, a kitchenette, a walk-in closet, a marble bathroom, and access to the Grand Club Lounge
findings.note: This is the Diplomat Suite description, and it covers all four listed features.

claims.text: Club Oasis has a 24-hour fitness center and an exercise studio with classes such as yoga and aerobics.

findings.quote: Club Oasis features a 24-hour fitness center with modern equipment and an exercise studio offering classes such as yoga and aerobics
findings.note: Both the fitness center and the exercise studio classes are stated.

claims.text: Club Oasis has separate men's and women's wet areas with a sauna, steam room and whirlpools.

findings.quote: Guests can relax in separate men’s and women’s wet areas, including a sauna, steam room, and whirlpools with micro bubble and jet systems.
findings.note: The separate wet areas, sauna, steam room and whirlpools are all stated.

claims.text: Pearl Liang serves Cantonese cuisine in a private-residence-style setting by designer Tony Chi.

findings.quote: Enjoy authentic Cantonese delicacies, fresh seafood and dim sum in an elegant ambience. Indulge in Tony Chi's "private residence" dining setting
findings.note: The page confirms the Cantonese cuisine and Tony Chi's private-residence setting.

claims.text: At Café, a team of 30 chefs cooks Asian specialties in a show kitchen.

findings.quote: A 30-chef team cooks up Asian specialties in a show kitchen at Café
findings.note: The 30-chef team, Asian specialties and show kitchen are all stated.

claims.text: Pets are welcome, with a pet-friendly package of rooms, amenities and services designed for dogs.

findings.quote: We offer a “Furry Friend” pet-friendly package featuring rooms and suites with amenities and services designed for your beloved dog companion.
findings.note: This appears under the heading "Pets Are Welcome".

claims.text: The hotel has a bridge that connects directly to Taipei 101.

findings.quote: the only 5-star hotel in Taipei with a bridge that directly connects to Taipei 101
findings.note: The page states the direct bridge to Taipei 101.

claims.text: Rooms and suites look out on Taipei 101, Taiwan's tallest skyscraper, right next door, as well as other city views.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Taipei's rooms and suites offer stunning views of Taipei 101, which is Taiwan’s tallest skyscraper and next door, as well as other city views
findings.note: Taipei 101 views, tallest skyscraper, next door and other city views are all covered.

claims.text: The temperature-controlled outdoor pool on level 5 is set in lush landscaping, with sun beds, lounge areas and a pool bar.

findings.quote: Taipei's unique temperature-controlled outdoor swimming pool on level 5, with its lush landscape, stylish yet comfortable sun beds, lounge areas and a pool bar
findings.note: Every pool feature in the claim is stated.

claims.text: The Grand Club Lounge on the 22nd floor has panoramic views of the Taipei skyline, with continental breakfast, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail experience.

findings.quote: Located on the 22nd floor of the hotel, the Grand Club Lounge offers panoramic views of the Taipei skyline, an intimate atmosphere along with a continental breakfast, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail experience.
findings.note: The floor, views and all three offerings match.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite is an apartment-style suite with a 24-hour private butler.

findings.quote: Enjoy the exclusive privileges including a 24-hour private butler and access to the Grand Club Lounge by staying in the 2,379 sq ft (221 sq m) apartment-style suite.
findings.note: This is the Presidential Suite description, confirming the apartment style and 24-hour butler.

claims.text: The hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities, so bring your own essentials and a drinking vessel.

findings.quote: our hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities for staying guests. We recommend bringing your own essentials and a drinking vessel to refill with drinking water
findings.note: The page states both the policy and the recommendation to bring essentials and a drinking vessel.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the busy urban setting may not suit travelers seeking tranquility.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's luxury positioning.
